app.title: MnemoBreach
app.subtitle: Where your data has leaked. Answers come from Have I Been Pwned and XposedOrNot.
app.browserMode: Opened outside Mnemosyne: your list is saved in this browser only.
app.truth: Nobody can remove your data from a leak. A service that sells you that is lying.

profile.title: Your identifiers
profile.hint: Add only your own email addresses and phone numbers. They stay on this machine, stored unencrypted in this app's settings, and are shown masked.
profile.loadError: Your list could not be read.

errors.INVALID: This is neither an email address nor a phone number.
errors.FULL: The list holds {{max}} of each kind.

account.title: Search your emails in known breaches
account.leaves: Searching sends the email you choose to Have I Been Pwned, with your own key. Nothing else leaves this machine.
account.open: Use my Have I Been Pwned key
account.keyPlaceholder: Your Have I Been Pwned API key
account.keyWhere: The key is sold by Have I Been Pwned on haveibeenpwned.com/API/Key. It is sealed on this machine and this app can never read it back.
account.keyPlaintext: This machine cannot encrypt it: it is stored readable on disk.
account.keyWarning: Saved. This key does not look like the usual 32 characters: if searches are refused, check it.
account.absent: Absent from the known breaches, checked {{when}}. That does not make it safe.
account.rememberedWalled: Saved in this app's vault. The chat reads it once you unlock the vault in the vault panel.
account.phonesLater: Phone numbers cannot be searched yet.

errors.KEY_REFUSED: Have I Been Pwned refused this key. Check it or replace it.
errors.USER_AGENT_REFUSED: Have I Been Pwned refused the request. Nothing was concluded.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many searches for your key's plan. Wait a moment.
errors.TIMEOUT: No answer in time. Nothing was concluded.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach Have I Been Pwned. Nothing was concluded.
errors.NOT_DECLARED: This address is not in your list.
errors.HAS_WHITESPACE: The key contains a space. Copy it again.
errors.LOOKS_LIKE_URL: This is a web address, not a key.
errors.SEAL_REFUSED: The key could not be saved on this machine.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission refused. You can allow it again from the cartridge's permissions.
errors.FAILED: It did not work. Nothing was concluded.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_WAIT: Too many searches for your key's plan. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_WAIT_one: Too many searches for your key's plan. Try again in 1 second.
errors.FORGET_FAILED: The vault refused to forget. Your saved results are kept, try again.

account.forgottenUnknown: Forgotten. The vault did not say how many.
account.sensitiveNote: Have I Been Pwned leaves breaches it marks as sensitive out of this search, so an address can be absent here and present in one of them.
account.leavesXon: Searching sends the email you choose to XposedOrNot, a free service. Nothing else leaves this machine.
account.attributionXon: Results from XposedOrNot. Its dates are known to the year only.
account.keyTitle: More complete: your own Have I Been Pwned key
account.keyWhy: With a key, searches go to Have I Been Pwned instead: dates to the day and its own list of breaches. The key is paid.
account.manualHint: Free: search your address yourself on Have I Been Pwned, or get an email when it appears in a new breach. Then add what you find to your timeline from the list below.
account.manualNotify: Get an email for new breaches
account.linkFailed: The page did not open. The address is haveibeenpwned.com.

password.title: Test a password
password.hint: The password is hashed on this machine. Only the first 5 characters of the hash are sent.
password.found: Seen {{count}} times in known breaches. Do not use it anymore.
password.absent: Absent from the known breaches, checked {{when}}. That does not make it safe.

errors.NO_CRYPTO: This window cannot hash. Nothing was sent.
errors.TIMEOUT: No answer within 15 seconds. Nothing was concluded.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the service. Nothing was concluded.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many checks. Wait a few seconds.

password.found_one: Seen once in known breaches. Do not use it anymore.

catalogue.title: All known breaches
catalogue.search: Search a service or a domain
catalogue.error: The list could not be loaded.
catalogue.flaggedTitle: Flagged by Have I Been Pwned as fake data or spam lists

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a few seconds.

severity.sensitive: Sensitive data (ID, bank, health, private life)

timeline.title: Your timeline
timeline.empty: No breach on your timeline yet. Search one of your emails above, or open a breach in the list below and say you had an account there.
timeline.crossMulti: {{count}} breaches hold several of your addresses together: {{names}}.
timeline.crossContact: {{count}} breaches leaked phone numbers or postal addresses alongside your email: {{names}}. That is enough for a convincing call or letter.
timeline.learned: On your timeline {{span}} after the breach.
timeline.sourceFound: Found by a search of {{count}} of your addresses.
timeline.sourceDeclared: You said you had an account here.

action.password: Change the password of this service, and everywhere you reused it
action.phishing: Watch for emails that quote this service
action.calls: Watch for calls and texts that quote this service
action.mail: Watch for letters that quote this service
action.antivirus: Scan your computers with an antivirus: this leak comes from malware that read a machine
action.allPasswords: Change all your passwords, starting with your email and your bank

timeline.crossMulti_one: 1 breach holds several of your addresses together: {{names}}.
timeline.crossContact_one: 1 breach leaked phone numbers or postal addresses alongside your email: {{names}}. That is enough for a convincing call or letter.
timeline.sourceFound_one: Found by a search of 1 of your addresses.

news.title: New breaches
news.noCatalogue: The list of breaches could not be loaded, so nothing can be compared.
news.first: First visit: the current list is remembered. New breaches will show here next time.
news.mine: {{count}} new breaches on a service of your timeline:
news.more: and {{count}} more in the list below
news.watchNothing: Put a breach on your timeline to be able to watch its service.
news.watchPrice: Once a day, even with this window closed, Mnemosyne asks Have I Been Pwned whether the {{count}} services of your timeline have a new breach, and notifies you. Have I Been Pwned sees the list of these services, never your email. It only runs while Mnemosyne OS is open.
news.watchSkipped: {{count}} services of your timeline are not watched: the limit is 12, the most recent are kept.
news.watchOnlyOpen: Nothing runs while Mnemosyne OS is closed.
news.inbox: Found while the window was closed ({{count}}):
news.mine_one: 1 new breach on a service of your timeline:
news.more_one: and 1 more in the list below
news.watchPrice_one: Once a day, even with this window closed, Mnemosyne asks Have I Been Pwned whether the service of your timeline has a new breach, and notifies you. Have I Been Pwned sees the name of this service, never your email. It only runs while Mnemosyne OS is open.
news.watchSkipped_one: 1 service of your timeline is not watched: the limit is 12, the most recent are kept.
news.inbox_one: Found while the window was closed (1):
news.watchEmpty: Your timeline has no service left: nothing is being watched.
